correctness.rationale: A width-biased Gaussian hyperplane representation yields an exactly normalized Gaussian-threshold mixture. Signed-coordinate face enumeration proves the joint finite-dimensional law without probabilistic approximations. Face-range integration gives expectations. Gaussian maximum convergence plus binomial concentration yields the uniform offset and shared log-exponent limits. Dominant one-high-vertex face counts prove deterministic ratios and, combined with exact expectation order, nonrepresentative means. The standalone checker verifies finite enumerations and independent integral identities but is not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: It fully solves a natural invariant affine-section face-vector distribution for every dimension, provides all expected face counts, and identifies a joint continuous exponent with deterministic cross-rank ratios and a rare-event dominated mean. This supplies structural high-dimensional stochastic geometry beyond known support/gap sets or metric extremal sections; its value does not rest on a small numerical improvement.
